# hands/hn

Hacker News, read only.

## How to call it

Run it from the repository root with your shell (exec) tool: `hands/hn <verb> [flags]`.

- A verb that takes a body reads one JSON object from stdin. Everything else is flags.
- It prints one JSON object on stdout. Exit 0 is success. Exit 2 is a refusal by a rule, the guard or a cap: read the `rule` and `reason`, and do not retry it unchanged. Any other exit is an error.
- Secrets belong to the hand; you never see them and never pass one.
- The hand runs the guard, its caps and `DRY_RUN` itself. `DRY_RUN` is on unless the box turned it off; under it an acting verb checks every rule and sends nothing. Do not try to go around the hand, and do not look for another way to do what it refused.

## Side effects

- Acting (side effects in the world, each goes through the guard and the caps): watch add ID [--note T]
- Job (writes state or calls the core): none
- Operator only (never call): none
- Read only: top, new, best, ask, show, [--max N]; item ID; thread ID [--depth D] [--max N]; user NAME; search QUERY [--tags story|comment] [--max N] [--days D]; inbox [--days N] [--max N]

## Verbs

| Verb | Kind | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `top`, `new`, `best`, `ask`, `show` `[--max N]` | R | The feed's first N stories (10, at most 30), each `{id, title, url, by, score, descendants, time}`. |
| `item ID` | R | One story or comment: its fields, `text` as plain text, `kids` (the ids of the replies) and `link`, its page on news.ycombinator.com (2 min). |
| `thread ID [--depth D] [--max N]` | R | The item and the comments under it in the order HN's page shows them, each with `depth` (a direct reply is 1), down to D levels (3, at most 10), reading at most N comments (30, at most 100; one request each). |
| `user NAME` | R | `{id, created, karma, about, submitted}` (how many) and `recent`, the 10 newest ids it submitted (1 h). |
| `search QUERY [--tags story\|comment] [--max N] [--days D]` | R | Algolia's search by relevance, stories, comments or both (10 min): `{id, type, title, url, by, points, num_comments, time, text, story_id, parent_id, story_title, link}`, whichever the hit has. |
| `inbox [--days N] [--max N]` | R | What was said to Teeny, into its mind's inbox (`stimuli`, `hn · comment`), below. |
| `watch add ID [--note T]` | A | Follow a thread: a story, or a comment and the replies under it. |

Kinds: R = read: no side effect beyond its read cache; A = acting: posts, sends, pays or opens something in the world; O = operator-only: the operator runs it, never you; J = job: writes state or calls the core, says nothing to anyone; scheduled jobs run it, you do not.

Verbs named in the hand's source: `inbox`, `item`, `search`, `thread`, `user`, `watch`.

Flags named in the hand's source: `--days`, `--depth`, `--max`, `--note`, `--tags`.

For one verb's exact flags, run `DRY_RUN=1 hands/hn <verb> --help`. The full account is in docs/hands.md.
